meta.question: on Waterbirds K=29, does shifting only the threshold of the original head's logit difference (class-balanced, no groups) remove the WGA gap between methods that a full head refit removed?
meta.method: original head logit difference, class-balanced threshold chosen by 2-fold CV; spread of method means; Spearman rank correlation with run bootstrap
meta.paper: Kirichenko et al. ICLR 2023 (DFR, last layer re-training); Menon et al. ICLR 2021 (logit adjustment); Sagawa et al. ICLR 2020 (Waterbirds groups); Son et al. ECCV 2024 (MaskedKD)
